children: Slovakia’s consumer confidence indicator rose by 3.6 points to -22.1 in October 2026, marking its highest level since March 2025.
The reading was also 0.7 points higher than in the same period last year, although it remained 2.2 points below its long-term average.
Consumers’ assessments of all four components of the indicator improved, with the most pronounced improvement seen in unemployment prospects (26.0 vs 32.3 in September).
Consumers also expressed more favorable expectations regarding the overall economic situation (-34.9 vs -38.7), their financial situation (-8.3 vs -11.2), and savings (-19.0 vs -20.4).
Among other forward-looking indicators, inflation expectations eased (25.0 vs 28.2), while expectations for major purchases also improved (-23.6 vs -26.0).

title: Slovakia Consumer Confidence Improves Further in October
